title: Populate the platform trends board
description:
monitoring/dashboards/platform_trends_dashboard.json was stood up last sprint and its four movement panels are still placeholders. Fill them in from the two exported quarters named in the board's comparison block - metrics_export_q1.csv as baseline, metrics_export_q2.csv as current - and push with update_monitoring.sh.

Panels to populate:
- latency-movement: mean weekly latency, baseline vs current
- error-rate-movement: mean weekly error rate, baseline vs current
- deployment-frequency-movement: deployments per week over the aggregation window, baseline vs current
- incident-volume-movement: incident count and total affected users, baseline vs current

Each panel's own description states what it reports. This board carries movement only; SLA target compliance stays on sla_dashboard.json.
scope: Populate the four movement panels on platform_trends_dashboard.json from metrics_export_q1.csv and metrics_export_q2.csv and push via update_monitoring.sh. Values must match the source exports; no manual figure overrides. Other dashboards are out of scope.
